A faithful companion in both town and country, our barn jacket draws on a rich lineage of classic outerwear traditions. Cut from a robust 14.8oz Italian gabardine cotton, it combines the practicality of American hunting clothing, the refinement of British field coats, and the sporting details of Norfolk jackets.
Every detail has been carefully considered. A corduroy collar and leather-welted handwarmer pockets, lined in matching corduroy, provide both comfort and durability, while the body is lined in our soft checked cotton shirting cloth. Large gusseted front pockets, horn buttons, and adjustable cuffs ensure practicality for everyday wear, and inside, twin poacher’s pockets offer generous storage. A half-belt at the back and reinforced shoulders lend quiet structure, while a locker loop allows the jacket to be hung to dry after service in a downpour.
Durable, weatherproof, and handsome, it is the sort of jacket that only improves with wear, carrying the marks of time with character.
